code.note: Unpack 934.zip into an empty directory. The shipped Makefiles call nagfor; the rerun should compile F90/Src and F90/Drivers/Driver.f90 with gfortran (record the compiler and flags) and run the Driver. The claim uses only the first printed block of Driver's output (the angular function). The Wronskian_Table_I_Linux_Cluster.dat file and the radial function block are not part of the claim.

field: numerics (special functions: Mathieu functions for complex parameter q)

claim.location: F90/Drivers/RES inside 934.zip, first block: 'The value of the Mathieu angular function of even parity of order n= 1 for q= (-0.9,0.9) and argument x= 1.0 is (0.3779270959195549,0.1091782782532712)'. Driver.f90 computes this with hard-coded parity=0, der=0, n=1, q=-0.9D0+j*0.9D0, x=1.0D0, choice=1 (MathieuAngular, Blanch_Complex).

reference.sha256: not computed for the member; the value is quoted here and compared as a number

claim.paper_value: The ACM article was not read; the claim is the code's own shipped reference output, not a value located in the paper.
claim.metric: The real and imaginary parts of the complex angular Mathieu function Se printed by Driver for n=1, q=(-0.9,0.9), x=1.0, even parity. Compared componentwise with the two numbers in RES.
claim.determinism: deterministic (fixed inputs hard-coded in Driver.f90; no random numbers)

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. RES prints 16 significant digits, so differences in the last digits are print rounding. Double-precision reordering across compilers and the Blanch continued-fraction convergence test can move the result by about 1e-13 to 1e-12 relative; 1e-10 absolute allows that. A wrong parity, order, q, or algorithm changes the value by orders of magnitude. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 5 minutes: compile about 5 Fortran files and run one evaluation.
cost.data_size: none (inputs are hard-coded; the Wronskian table is not used by the claim)
cost.data_licence: Netlib CALGO archive; use under the ACM/TOMS redistribution terms of the archive. The rerun should record it.

why: The driver evaluates one complex-parameter Mathieu angular function by a continued-fraction algorithm (Blanch) and prints the value; the number depends on the implemented algorithm and is not a closed form checkable on paper.
